# Litmatch Error History

> Full public ledger of problems met while building Litmatch (108 rows, 102 real, 6 false alarms): what broke, root cause, resolution, evidence, status, plus CI history. Nothing is withheld, open security and production findings included.

## Start here

- [roadmap.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/roadmap.md): what is still open, grouped; lessons
- [summary.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/summary.md): counts, CI numbers, playbook, method, limits
- [issues/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/index.md): all rows with status, tier, area, date, title
- [json/issues.json](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/json/issues.json): the ledger as data
- [search-index.json](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/search-index.json): machine search
- [sitemap.xml](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/sitemap.xml): all URLs
- [llms-full.txt](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/llms-full.txt): every issue in one file

## Open or in progress (16)

- [issues/P085.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P085.md): [open, frontend-ux] Guest reload mất device token → Matching 401
- [issues/P078.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P078.md): [open, dependencies] PR Dependabot đỏ vì chính sách minimumReleaseAge của pnpm
- [issues/P077.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P077.md): [open, windows-toolchain] Test hard-kill của run-stage lỗi trên Windows (exit 124)
- [issues/P075.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P075.md): [open, auth-security] OTP trả mã ngay trong response khi production bật OTP
- [issues/P074.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P074.md): [in-progress, deploy-config] Core API production crash lúc boot (media storage dev / thiếu biến R2)
- [issues/P065.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P065.md): [open, deploy-config] Production chạy bản cũ: route profile 404, thông báo Facebook cũ
- [issues/P063.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P063.md): [open, ci-cd] Test frontend (admin/web) timeout lặp lại
- [issues/P012.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P012.md): [open, auth-security] CodeQL: loop-bound-injection (high) ở common/hash/fnv1a.ts còn mở
- [issues/P104.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P104.md): [open, other] soul-match end phát lại soul.ended khi replay
- [issues/P103.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P103.md): [open, other] Phân trang cursor video-queue admin (pending_review tăng dần nhưng cursor dùng less-than;…
- [issues/P102.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P102.md): [open, other] Comment k8s lỗi thời
- [issues/P101.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P101.md): [open, other] Lời mời hết hạn kiểu lazy-expire không được persist
- [issues/P100.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P100.md): [open, other] getHiddenUserIds không có cửa sổ thời gian (cần quyết định sản phẩm)
- [issues/P099.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P099.md): [open, other] Ranked sort loại hàng có rankScore IS NULL
- [issues/P094.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P094.md): [open, matching] Giới hạn đã biết: advisory lock Palm/Movie Match, outbox chưa có consumer/retention
- [issues/P055.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/issues/P055.md): [open, ci-cd] Chưa bắt buộc required checks: PR vẫn merge được khi CI đỏ
